title: DeleteAdHocQueryExecutionResponse
description: Response from DeleteAdHocQueryExecution (best-effort cancel of a deferred run). Acknowledges the request rather than confirming completion; poll GetAdHocQueryExecution to observe query_was_cancelled.

status.description: Outcome discriminator: `cancellation_requested` — AppFx was asked to cancel the running command. Best-effort: a no-op if the query already finished or the key is unknown to the server instance that ran it.
